workflows.title: 获客：线索资格 → 内容草稿 → 体验计划 → 董事长反馈

phases.title: 核验咨询需求与购买条件
phases.instructions: Use the recorded lead intent and consent. State missing information. An unrecorded budget is zero and an unrecorded renovation stage is unknown. Never invent a customer budget or customer statements. fit=false is an admissible result; report the uncertainty.

phases.title: 生成门店社媒内容草稿
phases.instructions: Create a local draft only. Any product claim must cite a supplied evidence record. No customer identity, fake case, revenue promise or absolute device compatibility. Publication remains disabled.

phases.title: 安排授权范围内的体验计划
phases.instructions: Only create a proposed appointment plan using the customer appointment consent. Do not claim the customer has received or confirmed an invitation; external messaging is disabled.

phases.title: 向董事长交付获客证据汇报
phases.instructions: Explain local completed records, pending approvals and disabled external actions. Metrics come from the runtime and must not be invented.

workflows.title: 交付：勘测 → 方案BOM → 报价审批 → 交付计划 → 现场证据 → 反馈

phases.title: 生成可核验的方案与BOM
phases.instructions: Use only surveyed room IDs and catalogued SKU IDs. Every distinct SKU pair needs an exact current compatibility record. Missing manufacturer evidence must stop the task, never be filled by a model guess.

phases.title: 形成毛利可计算的报价草案
phases.instructions: Return integer cents. Runtime calculates price/cost/gross margin and requests human approval. Do not represent a draft as sent, approved or paid.

phases.title: 编排备货、安装、调试与验收
phases.instructions: After human quote approval, produce four ordered milestones. Local scheduling never proves physical delivery. Wait for a human-supplied contract and field evidence; do not manufacture device serials, photos, signatures or customer acceptance.

phases.title: 向董事长交付项目验收证据汇报
phases.instructions: Report recorded procurement, installation, commissioning and customer acceptance. Distinguish local human-supplied evidence from externally verified facts and synthetic test evidence.

workflows.title: 售后：故障分级 → 处置计划 → 人类服务证据 → 回访

phases.title: 诊断故障类别与安全风险
phases.instructions: Never instruct a customer to open a powered electrical panel or disable a safety/security system. Safety/privacy issues require a qualified human specialist. Hypotheses must be marked unconfirmed.

phases.title: 准备有边界的售后处置方案
phases.instructions: Produce a local plan. Service completion needs a human-supplied service record and customer confirmation. No remote device-control connector is enabled.

phases.title: 售后证据与回访反馈
phases.instructions: Report the customer-confirmed local resolution, follow-up plan and any unresolved risks. Do not claim that a message was actually sent.

workflows.title: 自主经营：状态诊断 → 目标分解 → 董事长汇报

phases.title: 基于账本诊断经营缺口
phases.instructions: Read the exact metrics in the task context. Every reported metric value is checked against current runtime measurements. Unconnected external data must be described as unavailable.

phases.title: 拆解可执行经营任务
phases.instructions: Each action names the accountable employee for that installed skill. Every action creates a claimable employee-work planning task; objectRefs default to this store when omitted. A proposed goal with an exact leadId/surveyId/ticketId starts a local business workflow. A proposal without its prerequisite reference is saved as waiting-input. None of these tasks authorizes external spending, publishing or customer contact.

phases.title: 生成董事长决策包
phases.instructions: Return evidence-based local achievements, bottlenecks, proposed goals and decisions awaiting human action. The owner can respond through goal.instruct.

workflows.title: 按岗位技能执行有据可查的准备任务

phases.title: 读取岗位规程，生成计划与人类待决包
phases.instructions: Execute the assigned installed skill for the explicit brief, using only assigned current object references. Return a structured analysis, draft or plan and mark missing evidence. This phase persists a local planning report only. It cannot publish, render video, contact customers, pay, control devices, attest onsite work or create human consent, approval or acceptance. Evidence references must name assigned objects with their exact versions. Next actions name the accountable employee of the requested skill and existing same-store object references.
